title: Princeton random event generators affected by heart-centeredness

tellings.quote: Dirty Little Secret that like he's like yeah you know this is well known in reeg random event generator circles is that your heart centeredness is somehow commensurate with your ability to affect the output on the random event generator

plain: At a Princeton University lab that tested whether the mind can affect machines, the story goes, people found that how warm and open-hearted a person is tracks how well they can sway a random event generator, a device that churns out random results like electronic coin flips. Michels tells this in a 2025 episode, passing on what an unnamed friend from that lab told him, who called it a "dirty little secret" that is "well known" among researchers of these machines. If true, it would tie the heart, not just willpower, to the mind's reach over matter.
